На основе структурной схемы управления или эквивалентной схемы на изображении представьте аннотацию в форме дифференциально-алгебраических уравнений (DAE) для динамического моделирования, включая блоки управления, входы, состояния, выходы, дифференциальные и алгебраические уравнения.

conversations.value:
<image>
请基于图中的控制/等效框图，输出用于动态建模的DAE标注，包含控制单元、输入、状态、输出、微分方程与代数方程。

{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"hard","control_units":["Thermal generation branch","Hydro generation branch","Gas generation branch","PV and wind branches","Frequency response and droop feedback"],"inputs":["U_T","U_H","U_G","U_PV","U_wind","DeltaP_D"],"states":["x_Tg","x_Tr","x_Tt","x_Hg","x_Hr","x_Hw","x_Gg","x_Gc","x_Gr","x_Gd","x_P1","x_P2","x_W","f"],"outputs":["f"],"differential_equations":["d(x_Tg)/dt = (e_T-x_Tg)/T_SG","d(x_Tr)/dt = (x_Tg-x_Tr)/T_R","d(x_Tt)/dt = (v_Tr-x_Tt)/T_T","d(x_Hg)/dt = (e_H-x_Hg)/T_GH","d(x_Hr)/dt = (x_Hg-x_Hr)/T_RH","d(x_Hw)/dt = (v_Hr-x_Hw)/(0.5*T_W)","d(x_Gg)/dt = (e_G-c_g*x_Gg)/b_g","d(x_Gc)/dt = (x_Gg-x_Gc)/Y_c","d(x_Gr)/dt = (v_Gc-x_Gr)/T_F","d(x_Gd)/dt = (v_Gr-x_Gd)/T_CD","d(x_P1)/dt = K_1*U_PV-a_1*x_P1","d(x_P2)/dt = x_P1-a_3*x_P2","d(x_W)/dt = U_wind-x_W/T_WT","d(f)/dt = (K_PS*(P_sum-DeltaP_D)-f)/T_PS"],"algebraic_equations":["e_T = U_T - f/R_1","e_H = U_H - f/R_2","e_G = U_G - f/R_3","v_Tr = k_R*x_Tg + (1-k_R)*x_Tr","v_Hr = (T_RS/T_RH)*x_Hg + (1-T_RS/T_RH)*x_Hr","v_Hw = -2*v_Hr + 3*x_Hw","v_Gc = (X_c/Y_c)*x_Gg + (1-X_c/Y_c)*x_Gc","v_Gr = (T_CR/T_F)*v_Gc + (1-T_CR/T_F)*x_Gr","v_P = x_P1 + (a_2-a_3)*x_P2","P_sum = K_T*x_Tt + K_H*v_Hw + K_G*x_Gd + v_P + x_W"],"notes":"x_Tg,x_Tr,x_Tt are thermal governor/reheat/turbine memories; x_Hg,x_Hr,x_Hw hydro governor/reset/water memories; x_Gg,x_Gc,x_Gr,x_Gd gas governor/two compensator/turbine memories. x_P1 is PV first-stage output, x_P2 its denominator companion in x_P1*time units; x_W wind output and f frequency deviation. Denominator times,b_g,c_g,a_1,a_3,R_1,R_2,R_3>0; K_T,K_H,K_G,K_1,K_PS!=0; other coefficients are finite. All generation commands and load disturbance are external. Wind transfer has numerator T_WT and gas compensation numerator 1+s*T_CR."}

Based on the control/equivalent block diagram in the image, provide DAE annotations for dynamic modeling, including control units, inputs, states, outputs, differential equations, and algebraic equations.
annotations.es:
<image>
A partir del diagrama de bloques de control o equivalente de la imagen, proporciona anotaciones DAE para el modelado dinámico, incluidas las unidades de control, las entradas, los estados, las salidas, las ecuaciones diferenciales y las ecuaciones algebraicas.
annotations.ar:
<image>
استنادًا إلى مخطط كتل التحكم أو المخطط المكافئ في الصورة، قدّم توصيفًا بنظام المعادلات التفاضلية الجبرية (DAE) للنمذجة الديناميكية، يتضمن وحدات التحكم والمدخلات ومتغيرات الحالة والمخرجات والمعادلات التفاضلية والمعادلات الجبرية.
annotations.fr:
<image>
À partir du schéma fonctionnel de commande ou du schéma équivalent présenté dans l’image, fournissez des annotations DAE pour la modélisation dynamique, comprenant les unités de commande, les entrées, les états, les sorties, les équations différentielles et les équations algébriques.
